ingredients.name: milk
ingredients.description: Animal-derived liquid produced by mammary glands of cows
ingredients.alternatives: oat milk, almond milk, soy milk, coconut milk

ingredients.name: skimmed milk powder
ingredients.description: Dehydrated form of skimmed cow milk
ingredients.alternatives: soy milk powder, oat milk powder

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.description: Dairy fat product made from churning cream
ingredients.alternatives: vegan butter, coconut oil, olive oil

ingredients.name: cream
ingredients.description: High-fat dairy product from cow milk

ingredients.name: whey
ingredients.description: Milk protein byproduct from cheese making
ingredients.alternatives: pea protein, soy protein, rice protein, hemp protein

ingredients.name: casein
ingredients.description: Primary protein found in mammalian milk

ingredients.name: cheese
ingredients.description: Dairy product made by curdling milk

ingredients.name: yogurt
ingredients.alternatives: coconut yogurt, soy yogurt, almond yogurt

ingredients.name: ghee
ingredients.description: Clarified butter used in South Asian cooking

ingredients.name: egg
ingredients.alternatives: flax egg, chia egg, aquafaba, JUST egg

ingredients.name: mayonnaise
ingredients.description: Emulsion sauce made with eggs and oil
ingredients.alternatives: vegan mayo (made with aquafaba or soy)

ingredients.name: honey
ingredients.description: Produced by bees, not considered vegan
ingredients.alternatives: agave nectar, maple syrup, date syrup

ingredients.name: beeswax
ingredients.description: Wax produced by honeybees, used as coating agent

ingredients.name: gelatin
ingredients.description: Protein from animal bones, skin, and connective tissue

ingredients.name: tallow
ingredients.description: Rendered fat from cattle or sheep

ingredients.name: collagen
ingredients.description: Structural protein from animal connective tissues

ingredients.name: carmine
ingredients.description: Red dye derived from crushed cochineal insects

ingredients.name: shellac
ingredients.description: Resin secreted by lac bug used as glazing agent

ingredients.name: isinglass
ingredients.description: Fining agent from fish swim bladders, used in beer/wine

ingredients.name: rennet
ingredients.description: Enzyme from calf stomach used in cheese making

ingredients.name: vitamin d3
ingredients.description: Often derived from lanolin (sheep wool) or fish oil. Vegan D3 from lichen exists.

ingredients.name: vitamin d2
ingredients.description: Plant or yeast-derived vitamin D — vegan

ingredients.name: lecithin
ingredients.description: Emulsifier - typically from soy or sunflower (vegan), rarely from egg yolk

ingredients.name: natural flavors
ingredients.description: Can be derived from plant or animal sources. Contact manufacturer for clarification.

ingredients.name: mono and diglycerides
ingredients.description: Emulsifiers that can be derived from plant or animal fats

ingredients.name: l-cysteine
ingredients.description: Amino acid used in bread, often derived from poultry feathers or animal hair

ingredients.name: sugar
ingredients.description: Refined from sugarcane or sugar beet. Note: Some US cane sugar filtered through bone char — beet sugar always vegan.

ingredients.name: palm oil
ingredients.description: Vegan oil from palm fruit. Ethical concerns around deforestation.

ingredients.name: wheat flour
ingredients.alternatives: almond flour, oat flour, gluten-free flour blend

ingredients.name: sunflower oil
ingredients.description: Plant oil from sunflower seeds — vegan

ingredients.name: oats
ingredients.description: Cereal grain — vegan. May be cross-contaminated with gluten.

ingredients.name: almonds
ingredients.alternatives: sunflower seed butter, pumpkin seed butter

ingredients.name: vanilla
ingredients.description: Plant extract from vanilla orchid — vegan

ingredients.name: citric acid
ingredients.description: Organic acid from citrus fruits or fermentation — vegan

ingredients.name: ascorbic acid
ingredients.description: Vitamin C, usually synthetic or from plants — vegan

ingredients.name: high fructose corn syrup
ingredients.description: Refined sweetener from corn — vegan but ultra-processed

ingredients.name: guar gum
ingredients.description: Seed gum from guar plant — vegan

ingredients.name: agar
ingredients.description: Polysaccharide from red algae — vegan gelatin substitute

ingredients.name: carrageenan
ingredients.description: Thickener from red seaweed — vegan. Some controversy over gut health effects.

ingredients.name: yeast extract
ingredients.description: Yeast-derived extract — vegan. High in B vitamins.

ingredients.name: maltodextrin
ingredients.description: Carbohydrate from starch — vegan but highly processed

ingredients.name: caramel color
ingredients.description: Food coloring from heated sugar — vegan

ingredients.name: red 40
ingredients.description: Synthetic red dye — vegan but artificial

ingredients.name: yellow 5
ingredients.description: Synthetic yellow dye — vegan but artificial

ingredients.name: blue 1
ingredients.description: Synthetic blue dye — vegan but artificial

ingredients.name: beta-carotene
ingredients.description: Natural orange pigment from plants — vegan

ingredients.name: aspartame
ingredients.description: Artificial sweetener — vegan. Controversial health debates.

ingredients.name: stevia
ingredients.description: Natural zero-calorie sweetener from stevia plant — vegan

ingredients.name: sesame
ingredients.description: Seeds from sesame plant — vegan. Allergen in some countries.

ingredients.name: maple syrup
ingredients.description: Tree sap from maple trees — vegan

ingredients.name: agave
ingredients.description: Plant-based sweetener from agave — vegan. High fructose content.

ingredients.name: coconut sugar
ingredients.description: Sugar from coconut palm — vegan, low GI

ingredients.name: molasses
ingredients.description: Byproduct of sugar refining from cane or beet — vegan

ingredients.name: lactic acid
ingredients.description: Can be from fermentation (vegan) or dairy. Mostly plant-derived in food.

ingredients.name: glycerin
ingredients.description: Can be plant or animal derived. Vegetable glycerin is vegan.

ingredients.name: stearic acid
ingredients.description: Fatty acid that can be from animal or plant sources

ingredients.name: phosphoric acid
ingredients.description: Mineral acid used in sodas — vegan. Dental health concerns.

ingredients.name: caffeine
ingredients.description: Natural stimulant from plants or synthetic — vegan

ingredients.name: taurine
ingredients.description: In most commercial products now synthetic/fermentation-derived — vegan

ingredients.name: riboflavin
ingredients.description: Vitamin B2 — synthetic or fermentation-derived, vegan

ingredients.name: cyanocobalamin
ingredients.description: Vitamin B12 — synthetic form is vegan (produced from bacteria)

ingredients.name: seitan
ingredients.description: Wheat gluten protein — vegan. Not suitable for celiac.

ingredients.name: nutritional yeast
ingredients.description: Deactivated yeast with cheesy flavor — vegan

ingredients.name: aquafaba
ingredients.description: Liquid from cooked chickpeas — vegan egg replacer

ingredients.name: carnauba wax
ingredients.description: Wax from carnauba palm leaves — vegan alternative to shellac

ingredients.name: polysorbate 80
ingredients.description: Emulsifier from sorbitol and fatty acids — usually vegan

ingredients.name: magnesium stearate
ingredients.description: Can be from plant or animal stearic acid. Usually plant-derived.

ingredients.name: titanium dioxide
ingredients.description: Mineral white pigment — vegan. EU banned in food 2022.

ingredients.name: malic acid
ingredients.description: Organic acid from fruit or synthetic — vegan

ingredients.name: fumaric acid
ingredients.description: Organic acid from plant fermentation — vegan

ingredients.name: sorbitol
ingredients.description: Sugar alcohol from plant starch — vegan

ingredients.name: mannitol
ingredients.description: Sugar alcohol from seaweed or plant sources — vegan

ingredients.name: xylitol
ingredients.description: Sugar alcohol from plant xylan — vegan. Toxic to dogs.

ingredients.name: cellulose
ingredients.description: Plant fiber from wood pulp or cotton — vegan

ingredients.name: inulin
ingredients.description: Prebiotic fiber from chicory root — vegan

ingredients.name: wheat starch
ingredients.description: Starch from wheat — vegan but contains gluten

ingredients.name: vegetable oil
ingredients.description: Blend of plant oils — vegan. Hydrogenated versions contain trans fats.
